mainEntity.name: What permits are needed for an ADU bathroom in Alameda County?

acceptedAnswer.text: For an ADU bathroom installation in Alameda County, you will generally need plumbing, electrical, and building permits. These permits ensure that the work meets local safety and construction codes. The specific requirements can vary slightly between cities within Alameda County, such as Alameda, Berkeley, or Oakland. As a Preparation step, you should gather your proposed plans, including layout, plumbing schematics, and electrical plans, before applying. These documents are crucial for the city's plan check process.
acceptedAnswer.description: You generally need plumbing, electrical, and building permits for an ADU bathroom in Alameda County. Specific requirements can vary by city, so gather detailed plans before applying.
